# Metamorphic Relation (MR) for D1
# Meta-pattern: MP1 (Conservation)
# Invariant: The predicted probability of the MLP classifier is approximately conserved
# under a very small perturbation of the input, due to the continuity of the model.


def r(x):
    # Maps [0, 1] to [0.005, 0.995], which is strictly inside [0, 1].
    # The maximum perturbation |r(x) - x| is 0.005.
    return 0.99 * x + 0.005


def R(y_orig, y_new):
    # The output probability should be conserved within a very tight tolerance (0.01)
    # under this small perturbation.
    return abs(y_orig - y_new) < 0.01
